summary: Emotional needs flow with thinking and speech. This fluid pattern asks you to use emotional intelligence and clear thinking with awareness.
body: Emotional needs flow with thinking and speech. This fluid pattern asks you to use emotional intelligence and clear thinking with awareness. Thought and communication flow; expression is instinctive and fluent. The pattern can flow easily, which is useful when it is conscious and easy to take for granted when it is not. In practice, this can show up through emotional needs, thinking and speech, and the choices you make when mood-driven reaction or mental noise starts running the room.
gift: The gift is emotional intelligence, clear thinking, and a more conscious way to work with emotional needs and thinking and speech.
shadow: The shadow is mood-driven reaction, mental noise, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let emotional needs and thinking and speech cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Communication colored by mood; powerful when feeling and reasoning are integrated.
do: Name how emotional needs and thinking and speech are both involved
Turn emotional intelligence and clear thinking into one concrete choice
dont: Let mood-driven reaction make the decision
Ignore the needs of emotional needs or thinking and speech
